subject: Announcement: D3.5 Large datasets analysis engine

messages.author: 5900eadecec2d82d
messages.subject: Announcement: D3.5 Large datasets analysis engine
parts:
If you use Distance 3.5 and have very large datasets, you will be interested
in
the following.

A large datasets version of the Distance 3.5 Release 5 analysis engine is
available for download from the Updates and Extras page of the Distance home
page

http://www.ruwpa.st-and.ac.uk/distance/

This version can cope with up to 50 000 samples (lines, points, etc) and
100 000 observations (i.e., 10 times larger than the standard engine).
However, it uses more memory, so is not recommended unless you need it.

Full instructions for obtaining the large datasets engine are on the web
page.

- Len Thomas





--
Len Thomas, Co-ordinator
